records: Bitquery's Binance proof-of-reserves labels are third-party address attribution. The five XRPL source accounts have not been directly matched against Binance's official October 1 downloadable PoR address set.
CoinDesk's October 1 PoR crosswalk names Ethereum Binance 14; it does not establish the five XRPL source addresses' PoR membership or an XRP-specific reserve deficit.

TrackWhale's seven-day tracked large-transfer net outflow includes the Binance theft window and may be dominated by the incident. It is not a clean measure of voluntary holder withdrawals, broad exchange flow or new capital.
CoinDesk's institutional exchange-withdrawal report relies on anonymous sources and provides no amounts, destinations, assets or XRP-specific attribution.

CoinGlass/CoinDesk market-wide liquidations and TradRadar XRP-only rolling-window liquidations use different providers, venue coverage and timestamps; do not combine or average them without harmonized definitions.
Coinbase's cbXRP reserve page is an issuer-published point-in-time snapshot refreshed October 29. One reserve snapshot does not establish growth, net new XRP purchases or independent audit assurance.
XRPL fixCleanup3_5_0 is proposed but not merged or activated; no user impact or exploited exception was established in the cited Foundation statement.
No market feature was admitted from the new dashboards. The current panel is asynchronous, incident-contaminated and not calibrated for a fixed-horizon forecast.
